critical.title: Attention Needed
critical.description: One or more operational signals need immediate review.

warning.title: Monitor Closely
warning.description: No critical failures detected, but some signals need follow-up.

healthy.title: Healthy
healthy.description: No current integration, job, or heartbeat issues detected.

paused.title: Integration paused
paused.summary: This config is paused and provider polling skips delivery work for it.
paused.nextStep: Resume the config when notifications should continue.

retry.title: Retry scheduled
retry.summary: The next retry is scheduled for {date}.
retry.nextStep: Wait for the retry window before manually changing the integration.

active.title: Notification cooldown active
active.nextStep: No action is needed unless this config keeps missing expected notifications after the cooldown ends.

suppressed.title: Notification cooldown suppressed delivery
suppressed.summary: The last provider check found new content, but the config cooldown suppressed delivery.
suppressed.nextStep: Review the configured cooldown if this integration should announce more frequently.

configured.title: Notification cooldown configured
configured.summary: {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}} between deliveries.{lastDelivery}
configured.nextStep: Cooldown is configured but not currently blocking delivery based on the latest health metadata.

reviewQueue.groupedDetail: {detail} Includes {visibleCount, plural, one {1 visible detail} other {# visible details}}{extraCount, plural, =0 {} other {, plus # more summarized by the overview}}.
reviewQueue.failureCount: {count, plural, one {1 consecutive failure} other {# consecutive failures}}

issueDetails.integrationErrors: {value, plural, one {1 integration record currently failing.} other {# integration records currently failing.}}
issueDetails.failedJobRuns: {value, plural, one {1 recent job run failed.} other {# recent job runs failed.}}
issueDetails.jobStatusUnavailable: {value, plural, one {1 job status could not be loaded.} other {# job statuses could not be loaded.}}
issueDetails.healthWarnings: {value, plural, one {1 provider health warning or unknown state.} other {# provider health warnings or unknown states.}}
issueDetails.missingWorkerHeartbeat: The worker has not reported a heartbeat yet.
issueDetails.partialOverviewData: One or more admin overview requests failed.

twitch-auth.title: Twitch auth failed
twitch-auth.summary: The worker could not get a Twitch app token.
twitch-auth.nextStep: Check Twitch client ID and secret, then confirm the Twitch app is still active.

twitch-user-not-found.title: Twitch user not found
twitch-user-not-found.summary: The configured Twitch login no longer resolves through Helix.
twitch-user-not-found.nextStep: Verify the streamer username and update or pause the config if the account was renamed or removed.

youtube-feed-unavailable.title: YouTube feed unavailable
youtube-feed-unavailable.summary: The RSS feed for the configured channel returned no usable items.
youtube-feed-unavailable.nextStep: Verify the YouTube channel ID and check whether the channel feed is public and reachable.

tiktok-resolve-failed.title: TikTok lookup failed
tiktok-resolve-failed.summary: The worker could not resolve the creator live status.
tiktok-resolve-failed.nextStep: Open TikTok diagnostics, verify the username, and review the sanitized session state.

tiktok-auth-required.title: TikTok session likely required
tiktok-auth-required.summary: TikTok appears to require fresh session material for this lookup.
tiktok-auth-required.nextStep: Refresh the operator-managed TikTok session cookie and confirm diagnostics show a likely session cookie.

tiktok-rate-limited.title: TikTok rate limited
tiktok-rate-limited.summary: TikTok appears to be throttling live-status checks.
tiktok-rate-limited.nextStep: Wait for the provider cooldown and avoid repeated manual checks until polling recovers.

tiktok-user-not-found.title: TikTok user not found
tiktok-user-not-found.summary: The configured TikTok username does not resolve.
tiktok-user-not-found.nextStep: Verify the creator handle and update or pause stale TikTok configs.

bluesky-feed-unavailable.title: Bluesky feed unavailable
bluesky-feed-unavailable.summary: The configured Bluesky handle could not be loaded.
bluesky-feed-unavailable.nextStep: Verify the handle, then check Bluesky availability before changing the config.

patch-update-failed.title: Patch subscription update failed
patch-update-failed.summary: A patch note was announced, but saving the updated subscription state failed.
patch-update-failed.nextStep: Check API/database write health and retry the patch note job after the store is stable.

discord-send-failed.title: Discord delivery failed
discord-send-failed.summary: Discord did not return a message for the notification send.
discord-send-failed.nextStep: Check the destination channel exists and the bot can view and send messages there.

steam-news-poll-failed.title: Steam news poll failed
steam-news-poll-failed.summary: The Steam news poll failed for the configured app.
steam-news-poll-failed.nextStep: Verify the Steam app ID and check whether the public news feed is reachable.

auth.title: Authentication failure
auth.summary: The provider rejected credentials or an access token.
auth.nextStep: Verify provider credentials and rotate the relevant token or secret if needed.

rate-limit.title: Provider rate limit
rate-limit.summary: The provider appears to be throttling requests.
rate-limit.nextStep: Wait for the cooldown window, then reduce polling pressure if the same provider keeps failing.

not-found.title: Configured target not found
not-found.summary: The provider could not find the configured account, feed, or channel.
not-found.nextStep: Verify the configured identifier and pause or update stale configs.

network.title: Provider fetch failure
network.summary: The provider request failed or returned unusable data.
network.nextStep: Retry after a short interval and check provider status if failures continue.

discord.title: Discord destination issue
discord.summary: Delivery may be blocked by channel state or bot permissions.
discord.nextStep: Check the destination channel and bot permissions for view/send access.

unknown-status.title: Unknown health state
unknown-status.summary: The worker has not reported enough recent data for this integration.
unknown-status.nextStep: Check the worker heartbeat and wait for the next provider poll before changing config.
